title.en: Creating the Special Presidential Reorganization Committee

text.en:
The Committee herein created shall be known as Special Presidential Reorganization Committee. It
shall be composed of the following:
The President of the Philippines - Chairman
Hon. Cesar E. Virata, Minister of Finance - Vice-Chairman
Hon. Roberto V. Ongpin, Minister of Industry - Member
Hon. Armand V. Fabella, Chairman, Presidential Reorganization Commission - Ex. Director
Hon. Estelito P. Mendoza, Solicitor General - Member
(Representing Local Government)
Hon. Manuel S. Alba, Acting Minister of the Budget - Member
Hon. Rodolfo B. Albano, Member, Batasang Pambansa - Member
Hon. Cesar Zalamea, (Representing the Private Sector) - Member
Hon Francisco Tantuico , Presidential Adviser on Civil Service and Government Reorganization - Ex-Officio
The staff of the present Presidential Commission on Reorganization shall serve as the Secretariat of the
Committee herein created.

The Committee shall study the operational structure of the government and submit to the President its
proposals with the end in view of effecting simplicity, economy and efficiency in its operation.

The Committee created herein is authorized to call upon any ministry, bureau, office, agency or
instrumentality of the national government for such assistance as it may need in the performance of its tasks.

The Committee shall submit its initial report and recommendation to the President within thirty (30)
days from the date of this Order.

This Order shall take effect immediately.

Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
